name: AspectRatio
description: Style-neutral layout primitive that constrains arbitrary content to a caller-provided width-to-height ratio.

testing.rationale: Geometry-only wrapper with no component-owned interaction.

ratio.description: Width divided by height, for example 1 or 16 / 9.

children.description: Content constrained by the ratio container.

accessibility.notes: Layout-only wrapper. Accessibility semantics belong to its children.
